source_file: Methods/NMFS-Method/4 CPaulsen archived files/Paulsen 2002-2008/Charlie 08-2012/data/2008 SAS data extract pgms.sas
source_program: adults at any ladder 1.sas (program 1 of 4 in the file)
notes: First program in the file: selects the first BON/MCN/LGR/WELLS adult detection per tag_id, derives adult_year via year(datepart(max(obsdat8,obsdat9,obsdat10,obsdat27))) and age_at_return, then runs PROC CONTENTS/MEANS/FREQ. The PTAGIS source mergdata.all_to_01_2008 is not in the repo, so autoexec.sas builds a 13-row mock with the exact column shapes the program reads (tag_id BY var, the obsdat* detection datetimes, the per-site count flags, migration/tagging fields). libname paths redirected from the original D:/G: Windows paths to the bundle dir. The author's DATA-step logic, labels, and the three PROCs are kept verbatim. One cosmetic 'options sysprintfont=' line (printer font only, no analytic effect) was removed.
